faq.question: Is the leaderboard solo or team?
faq.answer: Both coexist. 25-player servers enable full-team pushes; Necromancer solo runs are also competitive via Soul Harvest scaling.

faq.question: What is the best class for the Survive Zombie Arena leaderboard?
faq.answer: Necromancer is the only S-tier class for leaderboard pushes — soul harvest and Death Nova area damage scale with late-wave zombie counts. Tactician anchor + Marksman carry + Medic sustain is the workhorse team comp.
